# cozystack_tenant_secret (Data Source)

Read a Cozystack TenantSecret by name and namespace.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) TenantSecret name.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace.

### Read-Only

- `data` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secret values keyed by name.
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier `namespace/name`.
- `type` (String) Secret type.
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID.
